task_language: pick up the book on the right and place it on the cabinet shelf

subtasks.name: place(right_book, cabinet_shelf, on)
subtasks.outcome: failed: moved toward the shelf's back side (120-220) but never over it, then carried away and set down behind the robot-left book

behaviour_summary: pi0 picks the correct book, carries it toward the back-left near the shelf (120-220) without reaching over the shelf top, turns away at ~240, and lowers it behind the robot-left book (280-340).
runs_trained_task: No libero_10 task exists in STUDY_SCENE4. The motion (grasp the image-left book, carry it to the robot's left / image right-back and set it down) resembles the STUDY_SCENE1 libero_10 task 'pick up the book and place it in the back compartment of the caddy', where the book starts on the image left and the caddy sits back-right; cross-scene transfer, low-medium confidence.

failures.mode_definition: Brings the grasped object to or toward the instructed destination, never releases it there, then carries it away from the destination.
hl_remedy: VERIFY the object is held at the destination (zoom ROI on the shelf)
HALT as soon as the EE starts moving away from the destination with the object still in hand
REPROMPT 'pick up the book on the right and place it on the cabinet shelf'
WATCH 5 s for a release at the destination; if pi0 again withdraws, ESCALATE (candidate for an RL place-on/under-shelf subtask)
failures.prevention: pi0 has never seen this shelf; coordinator should treat placements on/under unseen fixtures as high risk and keep the FR agent watching the destination ROI at the release moment.
failures.observation: 120-220 book held near the back-left (beside the plant, right of the shelf top), never above the shelf surface; 240 swung to the image right; 280-340 lowered and released behind the robot-left book; 360+ empty gripper.

notes: Partial approach only: the gripper stayed ~30-60 px right of the shelf top, so this could equally be wrong_destination_placement; labelled as abandonment because the transport initially headed toward the shelf. Released book is hidden behind the robot-left book / out of frame (evidence_offframe_release.png).
